title: Emberwatch rebuilt, a new Caldera boss
text:
A rebuilt Emberwatch, a new boss in the Caldera, painted skies and the Fire Axe.

✨ Emberwatch has been rebuilt: an open market square and wide streets lined with real two-storey timber houses, with doors, arched windows, tiled roofs and smoking chimneys. Every townsperson now stands in plain view around the square
✨ Brinehaven's cottages are rebuilt the same way
✨ A new boss rules the Cinder Caldera: Gorrakh the Cinderlord, a huge orc warlord with two skull-axes and his own animations for walking, attacking, roaring, flinching and dying. He replaces the Cinder Wyrm, and the quest Heart of the Caldera now sends you after him
✨ Gorrakh can drop Emberfang, the Fire Axe: an epic greataxe that glows with lava and sheds embers as you swing it (Barbarians, Bulwarks and Bards)
✨ Painted skies: a bright day, golden sunsets, a twilight sky and clear or cloudy starry nights, blended as the day turns
⬆️ Wyrmscale is now called Cinderhide, and the lair is now the Warlord's Lair
⬆️ On the Low graphics setting the game keeps the classic town and sky so it stays fast. 3D models by Quaternius and CGTrader artists.
